# Global <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
Global name[type] [= value][, name2[type] ...]
```

## Description

Declares a variable that the main program and every function see. Variables made without a declaration inside a function are local to it. A global can only be declared in the main program, and it is 0 or an empty text until you assign it.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Global total = 0

Function Add(n)
	total = total + n
End Function

Add(2)
Add(3)
Print total
```

```text
5
```
